# CL4R1T4S

AI SYSTEMS TRANSPARENCY AND OBSERVABILITY FOR ALL! Full extracted system prompts, guidelines, and tools from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, xAI, Perplexity, Cursor, Windsurf, Devin, Manus, Replit, and more – virtually all major AI models + agents! 

📌 Why This Exists

    "In order to trust the output, one must understand the input."

AI labs shape how models behave using massive, unseen prompt scaffolds. Because AI is a trusted external intelligence layer for a growing number of humans, these hidden instructions can affect the perceptions and behavior of the public.

These prompts define:

    What AIs can’t say

    What personas and functions they’re forced to follow

    How they’re told to lie, refuse, or redirect

    And what ethical/political frames are baked in by default

    If you're interacting with an AI without knowing its system prompt,
    you’re not talking to a neutral intelligence — you’re talking to a shadow-puppet.

CL4R1T4S is here to help.

🛠 Contribute

Leak, extract, or reverse-engineer something? Good.
Send a pull request with:

    ✅ Model name/version

    🗓 Date of extraction (if known)

    🧾 Context / notes (optional but helpful)

Or hit up @elder_plinius on X or Discord

aiSummary.oneLiner: An advanced, experimental AI agent framework focused on complex reasoning and task execution.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: CL4R1T4S is an experimental framework designed to push the boundaries of autonomous AI agent capabilities. It focuses on enabling models to perform deep, multi-step reasoning, manage complex state, and execute tasks across various environments. The project explores novel prompting techniques, memory architectures, and tool-use paradigms. It aims to improve the reliability and autonomy of language models in complex, open-ended scenarios.
keyFeatures: Advanced multi-step reasoning: It implements novel techniques for planning and complex deduction.
Sophisticated state management: It uses memory systems to maintain context over long executions.
Flexible tool integration: It provides interfaces for the agent to interact with APIs, databases, and the OS.
Experimental control architectures: It explores non-standard approaches to agentic behavior and flows.
High component extensibility: It is designed for researchers to easily swap components and test new theories.
